summary.text: Brian Cina is a Democratic and Vermont Progressive state representative from the Chittenden-15 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brian Cina was born in New Jersey and lives in Vermont.
Cina earned a bachelor's degree in music from Dartmouth College and a master's degree in social work from the University of Vermont.

Cina's career experience includes working as an Americorps member at Spectrum Youth and Family Services, in social services at Transitional Services for Youth and Families, and as owner of a private practice in clinical social work and psychotherapy.
Cina co-founded ISGOOD (Isham Street Gardening and Other Optimistic Doings), served on the Vermont Artificial Intelligence Task Force, and was a school board member.
In the 2023-2024 session, Cina served on the House Health Care Committee and was vice chair of the House Ethics Panel.
